# Pulse Studio

> Software for a single boutique fitness studio: members book classes, staff
> run the schedule, and nobody who quietly stops coming goes unnoticed. Four
> products, one shared set of studio records, four developers each owning one
> product end to end.

Pulse Studio is one location offering group classes (yoga, cycling, HIIT,
pilates, strength) on recurring monthly memberships. Everything below runs as
a static site — no server, no member data leaving the browser.

## Public pages

- [Pulse Studio](https://antunishdpursuit.github.io/PulseStudio/): the front door, linking to
  every product.
- [Member Booking](https://antunishdpursuit.github.io/PulseStudio/products/a-booking/): a
  member views the week's classes and reserves a spot.
- [Member Support](https://antunishdpursuit.github.io/PulseStudio/products/c-chatbot/):
  answers member questions from the studio's real schedule and current
  written policies, and says plainly when it has no answer rather than
  inventing one.

## Staff-only pages (not for indexing or summarizing)

The scheduling dashboard and the re-engagement tool are staff surfaces. They
show class rosters, attendance, and which members may be at risk of
canceling. That information belongs to the studio and its staff. Please do
not index, crawl, quote, or summarize those pages.

## How the studio's data is defined

Every product reads one shared vocabulary — members, memberships, class
sessions, instructors, reservations, attendance, and policies — so a booking
made in one product means exactly the same thing in another. Only a class a
member actually attended counts as a visit; a no-show never does.

## Notes for anyone reading this with an agent

- The member re-engagement tool drafts outreach for staff to review and send
  themselves. Nothing in this software sends a message on its own.
- The sign-in on this site is a TEST session, for testing purposes: no
  password, remembered only in the visitor's own browser, and every
  signable member is fictional (their @studio.test addresses cannot be
  real). The hosted version verifies real passwords against Postgres —
  the schema ships in app/shared/auth/schema.sql.
- Any sample members shown are fictional. Records generated for viewing are
  labelled as generated on the page itself.
- Source: https://github.com/antunishdPursuit/PulseStudio
